work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Revisit a source deferred in the previous W1 checkpoint and inspect one immutable repository revision for concrete harness identities, result artifacts, benchmark conditions, task isolation, evaluator path, model configuration and material unknowns. Admission is independent of outcome direction.

same benchmark repository revision
same local llama-server/proxy measurement membrane
same context size 262144, temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, seed 0 and max_tokens 32000
same 1800-second per-task wall-clock timeout
same single-machine execution and between-cell cooldown policy
same repository scoring path over stored patches
benchmark task worktree materialization/release per task

exact upstream Claude Code package version/revision

calendar execution date for each cell

persistent harness-side state outside benchmark task worktrees is not established for OpenCode or Claude Code
